field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Master switch. When set to No the Platform Overview page renders a notice and no backend is contacted.

field.label: Backend Timeout (seconds)
field.comment: Connect and read timeout applied to every backend probe. A backend that exceeds it is reported as unavailable instead of hanging the tab. Keep it low — 3 seconds is usually plenty on a private Docker network.

field.label: Result Cache (seconds)
field.comment: How long a collected snapshot is reused before the backend is probed again. Stops a held-down refresh from hammering the stack. Set to 0 to always probe live.

field.label: Auto Refresh (seconds)
field.comment: Interval at which the open tab reloads itself in the browser. Set to 0 for manual refresh only. Values below the result cache above just re-read the cache.

field.label: Show Tabs
field.comment: Which backends get a tab. Deselect anything this deployment does not run, so its tab does not sit permanently red.

group.label: Status Endpoints
group.comment: Only these backends need an address configured. Nginx, PHP-FPM and imgproxy publish their stats over HTTP rather than through a client library, RabbitMQ reports nothing over AMQP itself — its numbers come from the management API — and imgproxy is absent from Magento's own configuration entirely, so there is nothing to derive it from.

field.label: Nginx Status URL
field.comment: URL of an nginx stub_status endpoint, reachable from the PHP container. Leave empty to disable the Nginx tab's probe.

field.label: PHP-FPM Status URL
field.comment: URL of the php-fpm pm.status_path endpoint, reachable from the PHP container. The module appends its own query string to request JSON. Leave empty to show in-process PHP metrics only.

field.label: RabbitMQ Management URL
field.comment: Base URL of the RabbitMQ management API, for example http://rabbitmq:15672. Leave empty to derive it from the amqp host in app/etc/env.php on port 15672. Credentials are always taken from env.php, never entered here.

field.label: imgproxy Metrics URL
field.comment: URL of the imgproxy Prometheus endpoint, reachable from the PHP container. Start imgproxy with IMGPROXY_PROMETHEUS_BIND (for example ":4594") to publish it. This is a second listener and cannot share the port imgproxy serves images on, so it is not the IMGPROXY_BIND address. The OpenTelemetry metrics switch pushes to a collector instead and exposes nothing to read here. Leave empty to disable the imgproxy probe.
